No 3D/CG model material, photographic pores, neon rim, mature glamour, thick makeup or overly wet glass eyes. At small avatar size, her long pink silhouette, gray-blue gaze and contained lively smile should remain distinct.
True transparency surrounds the new bust. Keep the cutout alpha edge clean: fine hair belongs to the hair itself; no detached fluorescent red/yellow specks, contaminated matte fringe, background residue or outer glow. Warm highlights are inside real hair, not a halo. No circle, frame, gradient backdrop, black/white rectangle, fake checkerboard, room fragment, vignette, fog, shadow, speech bubble, letters, title, UI, logo, watermark or collage. One standalone original 2D human avatar only.
